workingPapers.title: Access recertification sample testing
workingPapers.testProcedure: Sampled 30 users across 6 applications; verified Q1 recertification evidence and revocation of unconfirmed access.

workingPapers.title: Change management CAB approval testing
workingPapers.testProcedure: Sampled 25 production changes; verified CAB approval, environment segregation and rollback documentation.

workingPapers.title: Patch SLA compliance testing
workingPapers.testProcedure: Tested critical/high vulnerability remediation timelines against the 30-day SLA for April–June.

workingPapers.title: Dealing error account walkthrough
workingPapers.testProcedure: Walked through error account postings for H2 FY26; verified compliance review evidence and board reporting of material errors.

findings.title: Privileged access recertification gaps in fund accounting application
findings.description: Two privileged accounts in the fund accounting application were not recertified in Q1 and lacked documented business justification.
findings.managementResponse: Accounts disabled pending review; recertification tool workflow extended to privileged accounts.

findings.title: Patch SLA breaches without approved exceptions
findings.description: Six critical/high vulnerabilities exceeded the 30-day remediation SLA without documented CISO exception approval.
findings.managementResponse: Concur. Compensating segmentation applied; platform upgrade closes root cause (tracked as TRT-2026-0003 and CEX-2026-0001).

findings.title: Backup restoration test evidence incomplete for two systems
findings.description: Quarterly restoration test evidence for the document management and email archival systems could not be produced for Q4 FY26.
findings.managementResponse: Restoration calendar extended to all tier-2 systems with evidence capture in the backup tool.

findings.title: Dealing error not reported to board within timeline
findings.description: One material dealing error in December was reported to the board 45 days after occurrence against a 30-day internal standard.
findings.managementResponse: Error reporting SOP amended with automated compliance calendar reminder.

findings.title: Passive breach rectification tracking manual and error-prone
findings.description: Passive investment restriction breaches were tracked in spreadsheets without systematic rectification timeline monitoring.
findings.managementResponse: Post-trade monitoring workflow now generates rectification tasks automatically.

followUpActions.title: Extend recertification workflow to privileged accounts
followUpActions.notes: Workflow configuration in UAT; production release planned mid-August.

followUpActions.title: Verify passive breach workflow operating for one full quarter
followUpActions.notes: Verification sample to be drawn after Q2 close.

followUpActions.title: Confirm board reporting SOP amendment operating
followUpActions.notes: Verified June board pack included the amended error report with no timeline breach.
